audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 read Skill on both layers while the prose says '​the equation flips hard back in your favour'; 2+ items read Riven while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say Vladimir owns it. Packet chart: Riven at 6, Vladimir at 2+ items.
audit.why: 50.68% over 2214 games with a scaling enemy — the late row was backwards on both layers.
audit.corrected: Level 6 -> Riven, 2+ items -> Vladimir, as matched full/content pairs plus the 2+ items rating.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly ordered: Lvl 2-3 W stun, Lvl 6 Blade of the Exile, 1st item pre-Rylai's, late full-AP Vladimir.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and spikes[1] call Wind Slash an execute that goes 'through any heal he banks'. Riven's R text describes a powerful ranged attack (projectile flag) with no execute and no healing interaction — healing is beaten by Grievous Wounds, not by Wind Slash.
audit.why: Two separate mechanics conflated; a player would skip anti-heal believing the R solves the healing.
audit.corrected: Wind Slash is a one-use ranged projectile. Transfusion (9/7.9/6.8/5.7/4.6s) and Hemoplague (120s) are the heal sources; Grievous Wounds is what answers them. Sanguine Pool (28/25/22/19/16s) grants 2s untargetable — wait it out rather than dumping the combo into it.

audit.why: Sanguine Pool is correctly identified as the punishable cooldown; its 16-28s range is now stated in spikes[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's itemization names Executioner's Calling but the content layer never mentions anti-heal at all, so the whole mid-lane section reads as if chip trades are fine.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags 'needs-antiheal' as applicable and unstated: Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades here.
audit.corrected: whys[3] now names Executioner's Calling at the exact level his Q heal starts scaling.

edits.before: He starts stacking AP and his Q heal climbs — only trade on pool cooldown and accept a slow phase rather than feeding his sustain with chip trades.
edits.after: His Q heal climbs with AP and its cooldown falls toward 4.6s — buy Executioner's Calling here, or chip trades just refill him and you bank nothing.

edits.before: Blade of the Exile extended range lets you open from outside E poke range and Wind Slash executes him through any heal he banks — this is your kill window.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile's extended range opens from outside his 600-range E, and Wind Slash is one ranged hit — carry anti-heal or Transfusion refunds the whole trade.

edits.before: Blade of the Exile's extended range lets you open from outside his E poke arc — Wind Slash executes him through any heal he tries to buy.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile's extended range opens from outside his 600-range E — hold Wind Slash for the moment Sanguine Pool (16-28s) drops him back out of it.

notes: Unverified: content.early claims Sanguine Pool 'costs 20% of his current HP'. The kit file lists W cost as 0 (Vladimir pays health, which Data Dragon does not expose), so I could not confirm the 20% figure from the kits and left the sentence untouched. Full-layer prose carries mojibake em dashes on disk; I proposed full-layer edits only on clean-ASCII enum fields to avoid before-mismatch.
